description: The holder's budget deadline (100 ns) passes during its 200 ns sleep and no checkpoint acknowledges it: the cancel is on its Cx only, the record stays Running and the body's return completes it Ok, so its exit is a normal one and the link cancels nothing: the peer sleeps on and finishes ok. The holder's join still reports Cancelled(Deadline) (the snapshot), which is not what the watches see.
